testcase.name: places start neither visited nor wishlisted
wishlist and visited are independent
a rating and an opinion are stored against the place
every category in the enum is represented in the seed
seeding is idempotent across repeated reads
first read seeds the full mumbai catalog
clearing the review of an unvisited place drops the row entirely
an opinion is trimmed rather than stored with its whitespace
a place can be rated without having been marked visited
state row is dropped once a place is neither visited nor wishlisted
marking visited persists the flag and the timestamp
undoing a visit clears both the flag and the timestamp
observePlaces re-emits when a place is marked visited
un-marking a visit keeps what the user wrote about the place
observeCity returns the seeded city
re-marking a visited place keeps the original timestamp
observePlace tracks a single place
a rating outside one to five is pulled back into range
a blank opinion is stored as nothing written
clearing one flag keeps the row while the other is still set
